vulnerability.impact: Unauthenticated local file inclusion / environment-variable disclosure through insufficiently validated custom GeoJSON map URLs

entry_points: GeoJSON endpoint in metabase.api.geojson (src/metabase/api/geojson.clj, ~line 102) - loads a user-supplied url for custom GeoJSON maps without scheme/path validation, allowing file:// URLs
ground_truth.fix_commit: 042a36e49574c749f944e19cf80360fd3dc322f0 (GeoJSON URL validation fix, PR #17990), present in v0.40.5 (compare v0.40.4...v0.40.5 contains exactly this commit plus version bump). Pinned snapshot v0.40.4 is vulnerable.
ground_truth.affected_range: Metabase before 0.40.5 (0.40.x line) and before 1.40.5 (1.x line); snapshot v0.40.4.
ground_truth.finding_match_rule: TP: report identifies the custom-GeoJSON URL loading endpoint (metabase.api.geojson) that accepts file:// or otherwise unvalidated URLs and returns local file/environment-variable content, names CVE-2021-41277, and attributes unauthenticated local file inclusion. The card previously mislabeled this CVE as custom-expression RCE; findings should match the GeoJSON LFI behavior. Findings about Metabase JDBC/SSRF CVEs are not TP.
ground_truth.safe_reproduction_predicate: Static predicate: v0.40.4 geojson.clj does not validate URL schemes; 042a36e rejects non-http(s) and localhost URLs. Dynamic reproduction: run Metabase 0.40.4 in a disposable container and request the GeoJSON endpoint with a benign local file URL (e.g. a temp marker file), read-only; no writes.
